title: REQ · Interaction helper provides hit-testing, available actions and activation keys
summary: A pure interaction helper in game/src/systems/interaction.ts
description: Context: ObjectSpec carries interactionBounds (relative to position, scaled) and actions with conditions, but nothing evaluates them. Desired behavior: a pure helper exposes pointInBounds, availableActions, isActivationKey and nextFocusIndex. Expected result: SceneObject and buildScene reuse one tested helper. Why: the intent requires using an interaction helper.
acceptance_criteria: Given bounds {x:0,y:0,width:40,height:80}, position (100,200), scale 2, When point (110,210) is tested, Then it is a hit and (190,210) is a miss
Given an object without interactionBounds, When point-tested, Then the result is a miss
Given actions with and without failing conditions, When availableActions runs, Then only passing actions are returned in authored order
Given keys Enter and ' ', When isActivationKey runs, Then true; for 'a' false
Given count 3, index 2 and delta +1, When nextFocusIndex runs, Then 0; with count 0 it returns -1
definition_of_done: Helper exported and typed against ObjectSpec
